import importlib.util,random,json
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(m)
r=random.Random(234)
services=['a','b','c']
def ex(d=0):
 if d==2 or r.random()<.55:
  op=r.choice(['match','startswith','endswith','contains']);return {'op':op,'path':[r.choice(services) for _ in range(r.randrange(4))]}
 op=r.choice(['true','false','not','and','or'])
 if op in ('true','false'):return {'op':op}
 if op=='not':return {'op':op,'arg':ex(d+1)}
 return {'op':op,'args':[ex(d+1) for _ in range(r.randrange(4))]}
def shuffle_expr(e):
 e=dict(e)
 if e['op']=='not':e['arg']=shuffle_expr(e['arg'])
 if e['op'] in ('and','or'):
  e['args']=[shuffle_expr(x) for x in e['args']];r.shuffle(e['args'])
 return e
for it in range(1000):
 rules=[{'action':r.choice(['allow','drop']),'when':ex()} for _ in range(r.randrange(1,10))]
 queries=[[r.choice(services) for _ in range(r.randrange(8))] for _ in range(10)]
 a={'services':services,'rules':rules,'queries':queries}
 rules2=[{'action':x['action'],'when':shuffle_expr(x['when'])} for x in rules];r.shuffle(rules2)
 b={'services':services,'rules':rules2,'queries':queries}
 oa=m.compile_bundle(a);ob=m.compile_bundle(b)
 assert oa==ob,(it,oa,ob)
print('1000 rule/commutative-argument reorderings produced identical output')
